title: SREV-057 box root DOS path publication boundary contract

box_file_raw_path.description: Raw root path returned by SbieApi_QueryProcessInfoStr fallback

contracts: UNICODE_STRING lengths are byte lengths for the destination buffer
wcscpy requires a valid destination buffer and a null-terminated source string
NTSTATUS results must be tested with NT_SUCCESS before publishing fallback data
SbieApi_QueryProcessInfoStr passes inout_str_len as a UNICODE_STRING MaximumLength byte capacity
The raw-root fallback accepts only byte capacities that fit UNICODE_STRING.MaximumLength
Dll_BoxFileDosPath is published only after allocation and translation succeed
Dll_BoxFileRawPath is published only after allocation, query success, and non-empty string proof
A null global root path must have a zero length gate
